title: Rounded corners payload
summary: JSON Schema for the rounded-corners payload - elements with bbox, median and per-corner radius, fit error, shape and outline source.
description: Emitted as the envelope payload by video_re_detect_rounded_corners; the envelope itself follows the baltor.video-detection/v1 schema.

review.notes: Valid example validates and invalid example fails (Draft 2020-12); the detector's tests validate every emitted payload against this schema.
